name: Ichinose Rika
source:
"I must hang in there and do my best!"

Diligent in both club work and studies, she's the epitome of an honor student. A girl who moved in right next to the protagonist, this honor student is adept at almost everything, but she can be obstinate and is unable to show her true self to others. Also likes cute things.

Favorite Food: All types of meat, ice cream
Hobbies: Writing in her diary blog
Residence: New residential area
Family: Father (works in the energy industry), Mother (same field as husband)

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/rika-ichinose/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
translation:
“我必须坚持下去，努力加油！”

她无论社团活动还是学习都很认真，是优等生的典范。她搬到主人公家旁边，几乎什么都擅长，却也很固执，无法向别人展现真实的自己。她还喜欢可爱的东西。

喜欢的食物：各种肉类、冰淇淋
爱好：写日记博客
居住地：新住宅区
家庭：父亲（能源行业）、母亲（与父亲从事同一行业）

[来源：[url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/rika-ichinose/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
